hello.speaker: pip
hello.text: Before you ask: no, I did not, and you cannot prove it. Pip Underbough. Locks, ledgers and ladders a speciality.

choices.text: I need someone who can open doors that do not want to be opened.

caught.speaker: pip
caught.text: ...Fine. Fine! Here. I was only seeing how heavy it was. You have good eyes. I like good eyes.

missed.text: She smiles at you with both hands in plain sight. You feel faintly lighter, somehow.

job.speaker: pip
job.text: A tomb? An old one, with old locks, and nobody alive to mind? I am in. Half of whatever is not nailed down.

choices.text: A fair share, same as everyone.

join.speaker: pip
join.text: Tight-fisted. Sensible. I can work with sensible. Lead on.
